query: Why do handling times differ by channel and priority?

per_column.name: issue_category
per_column.rationale: Categorising the free-text issue gives a genuine new axis to explain handling-time differences beyond channel/priority. Samples align well with source text (billing_inquiry, feature_request, outage all correct).

per_column.name: operational_urgency
per_column.rationale: Adds an urgency dimension distinct from the raw priority field and plausibly correlated with resolution time. Values are well-warranted readings: 'time_deadline_stated' for the Friday deadline, 'active_outage_declared' for the 14-min outage.

per_column.name: technical_complexity
per_column.rationale: A 1-5 complexity score is a strong candidate driver of handling time. It is an inferred/subjective rating rather than directly stated, but the sample scores are defensible readings of the described issues, so groundedness is moderate.

per_column.name: scope_of_impact
per_column.rationale: Blast-radius categorisation is a meaningful axis for explaining effort/time. Samples grounded: single_user for individual reports, entire_tenant for 'all members of the Acme tenant'.

per_column.name: root_cause_domain
per_column.rationale: Domain grouping offers useful stratification. Mostly grounded, but some inference: labelling the CS-0003 502 outage 'infrastructure_and_networking' is reasonable but not explicit, and auth/data domains are well supported. Slight risk of confident specifics where text is thin.

per_column.name: workaround_available
per_column.rationale: Presence of a workaround plausibly affects urgency and handling. Somewhat coarse and partly inferred (many defaulted to 'no_workaround'), but sample values are sound: 'customer_has_workaround' for the manual sed step, 'not_present' for feature request.

judge.rationale: All six columns give genuinely distinct axes (category, urgency, complexity, scope, root-cause domain, workaround) that a downstream analyst could group and model on to explain handling-time variation beyond the existing channel/priority fields; none are near-constant or trivially redundant. Values in the row_evidence_samples are consistent, warranted readings of the source text, with only mild inference on the subjective complexity score and some root-cause assignments. No clear hallucinations observed; silent-row defaults ('not_present') are appropriate.
